 TEAM LIST: Fredrick returns to Eagles’ defence for must-win clash against Tanzania 
 by Idris Shehu November 13, 2026 4:53 pm 
 Stay connected via Google News 
 Benjamin Fredrick will partner Calvin Bassey at the heart of the Super Eagles’ defence for their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifier against Tanzania.  
 Fredrick will start his first competitive match for Nigeria since he was injured a year ago. The 21-year-old’s only appearance for the Eagles during the period was in a friendly match against FIFA-banned Russia in early October.
 Czech-based Abdullahi Bewene gets his debut at left-back with Ola Aina on the opposite wing. Alhassan Yusuf and Tochukwu Nnadi come into the midfield in the absence of unpicked Frank Onyeka and Raphael Onyedika. Wilfred Ndidi captains the team, with Alex Iwobi operating as the creative clog.
 Without the injured Victor Osimhen, Eric Chelle, the Eagles’ head coach, names Akor Adams as the focal point of an attacking duo alongside Ademola Lookman. Stanley Nwabali remains the first-choice goalkeeper.

 The Eagles started the qualification campaign unconvincingly. The team won their first game at home 2-1 against Madagascar but lost 3-0 to Guinea-Bissau in the second match.
 They must defeat Tanzania, already qualified for the 2027 AFCON as one of the hosts, in the upcoming double-header. The first match kicks off at the Godswill Akpabio Stadium, Uyo, at 5 pm, while the second leg is scheduled for Dar-as-Salam on Tuesday.
 Super Eagles XI: Stanley Nwabali; Calvin Bassey, Benjamin Fredrick, Abdullahi Bewene, Ola Aina; Wilfred Ndidi, Alhassan Yusuf, Alex Iwobi, Tochukwu Nnadi; Ademola Lookman, Akor Adams.
